text:
maria: Heads-up — preflight for SEA-cluster bring-up tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Need final GPU slot reservation and scheduler window confirmation.
chris: On it. Do we want a hard reservation or soft slot (preemptible) for initial smoke tests?
maria: Hard reservation for first 2 hours of smoke tests. We can drop to soft after smoke passes. Need quota approved by cloud team.
sam: I pushed a qreq to the vendor dashboard: https://internal.tools/qreq/SEA-2212 — asked for 24 A100 slots for 4 hours starting 06:00. @neha can you watch for approval?
neha: Watching. I also opened a CAPEX note for short-term burst cost. If vendor asks, we should approve up to $4k for the initial reservation.
quota-bot: [automated] qreq SEA-2212 status: submitted -> awaiting vendor confirm. ETA vendor reply: 8h. Ticket: QR-78421.
maria: If vendor reply is slow, fallback plan: request spot pool slice + autoscaler policy with aggressive minReplica=0 -> 2 ramp. That keeps cost under check.
chris: Agree. Scheduler config I want to use:
```yaml
scheduler: "kube-gpu-scheduler-v2"
preemptionPolicy: "Never"
capacityReservation: true
reservedSlots: 24
reservationWindow: "06:00-08:00 UTC"
nodeSelector: {region: "asia-southeast1"}
```
chris: Will also attach node taints 'bringup:reserved' so normal workloads don't steal nodes.
maria: Good. Runbook checklist for tomorrow (quick):
- Confirm quota approval or vendor confirm (neha)
- Reserve billing approval (finance)
- Apply cluster-scheduler change (chris)
- Run smoke CI (devops-bot will trigger)
- Validate KV cache, model load time, and p99 latency (maria)
- Hand off to oncall with evidence and revert steps (sam)

sam: devops-bot, please queue smoke CI at 06:10 UTC once reservation shows as ACTIVE.
devops-bot: [automated] scheduled: smoke_ci/sea-bringup at 06:10 UTC; will re-run on failure up to 2 retries.
neha: Vendor answered — QR-78421 CONFIRMED for 24 A100 slots 06:00-10:00 UTC. They gave a soft-commit; asked for credit card hold.
maria: 👍 Good. Finance — can we proceed with the card hold? @chris loop with billing.
chris: Billing issued hold. Card masked ID ****4321. Charge cap $4k.
chris: Planning to apply scheduler change at 05:45 UTC, preflight 05:50 (node OS checks + nvml driver versions).
sam: Quick preflight command list (paste into ops runbook):
```
# check node readiness
kubectl get nodes -l bringup=reserved -o wide
# check driver
ssh ops@node01 'nvidia-smi -L && nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv'
# verify scheduler rules
kubectl get configmap gpu-scheduler -n kube-system -o yaml | sed -n '1,200p'
```
neha: Also verify networking egress to model weights bucket — we've seen timeouts in APAC. Run curl to s3 endpoint from reserved nodes.
maria: Noted. I will be oncall 05:30-09:30 UTC to monitor. If p99 latency > 250ms or model load fails, revert reservation by 07:00 and scale nodes down.
sam: If anything blocks, escalate to eng-sre #eng-sre and ping me.
chris: I'll post the exact kubectl rollout commands in the runbook in 15m.
maria: Thanks. After smoke and KPI checks, handoff steps to include: commit snapshot of node metrics, scheduler config, and an annotation on the cluster describing reservation id (QR-78421).
quota-bot: [automated] QR-78421 state updated: vendor_confirmed -> active-reservation. Reservation token: res_tok_421.
maria: Perfect. Final note — please keep all logs in /var/log/bringup/sea-2212 and tag the GitHub PR with bringup/sea-2212.
neha: Will do. :thumbsup:
chris: See you all tomorrow morning.
